about: Chelsea Sapphire Oware is a Ghanaian-born fine artist currently living and working in East London, UK. Her creative journey began in childhood, exploring various artistic disciplines including musical theatre, dance, creative writing, and music performance. Over time, she developed a deeper connection to fine art as a way of processing and soothing the emotional impact of parental loss.

Her work is deeply autobiographical, using visual language to express complex emotional states that often resist words. Through her paintings, Chelsea explores themes of identity, grief, detachment, and self-preservation.
